Used the shadcn MCP server to add the reusable [Button](~/work/jf-work/you-connect-your-agent-1795637863051/app/src/components/ui/button.tsx). The app’s counter now uses its outline variant and still increments on click.

The production build passed. Lint reported one Fast Refresh warning because the generated file also exports `buttonVariants`.
